what: QED active security checks, R13 second pass, AFTER the fixes, on branch claude/r13-security2 at 503da11 (merged with claude/r11-meridian 6466442); QED_SECURITY_PORT=11550; the interface built first (S52)
target: http://127.0.0.1:11550 on a scratch database (deleted with the temporary directory by the operating system)
harnessWrites: the address's recovery allowance cleared once, after showing it spent (instead of waiting an hour)
one approval's expiry set in the past (instead of waiting ten minutes)
session re-authentication time cleared (instead of waiting five minutes)
two legacy password accounts created with server/auth.ts hashPassword
one session pointed at a workspace its person does not belong to (N34)
one membership ended (N40; no route removes a member yet)
R13 second pass: one model call of a business owner with two proposals, as server/ai.ts stores them (R22, R23; the stack has no model)
one business notice of a vault recovery, as rail-signers.ts writes it (R25; no vault service on this stack)
one run of a protective instruction put in the waiting state, as the engine leaves it when a price crosses (R15)
